# Slider

Installed from shadcn-svelte nova using CLI 1.7.0 on 2026-10-22. The shared bank
owns the 44px interaction area and pane thumb; consumers supply bounded values,
labels and value changes only. Bits UI supplies keyboard and ARIA semantics.
Orientation selectors match the installed Bits UI `data-orientation` attribute;
the registry's newer shorthand selectors are not assumed to exist.
